title: GTA6 Confirmed to Feature RPG Mechanics Like Eating and Exercising
description: According to IGN Games, Grand Theft Auto 6 will feature RPG mechanics including eating, exercising, and more. Read our in-depth analysis of the gameplay details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Confirmed to Feature RPG Mechanics Like Eating and Exercising

Some of the first gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have recently surfaced, courtesy of IGN Games, indicating that Rockstar Games is embracing a more RPG-heavy style for the highly anticipated sequel. 

### A New Direction for Open-World Immersion

While Rockstar has previously experimented with survival and status elements in titles like Red Dead Redemption 2, the new report confirms that GTA6 will take things further by incorporating traditional role-playing game mechanics. Specifically, players can expect to engage in activities such as eating, exercising, and more within the game's expansive open world.

Although specific details on how these mechanics will impact gameplay stats—such as character stamina, appearance, or health—have not yet been fully detailed by the media outlet, the inclusion of these features points toward a heavily simulated world. Players may need to pay closer attention to their character's daily routines and maintenance, adding an extra layer of realism to the criminal sandbox experience.

### Analyzing Rockstar's Evolution

The integration of RPG systems marks a natural evolution for Rockstar Games as they leverage modern hardware to create more responsive and living virtual environments. Industry observers note that mechanics like exercising and diet management could heavily influence both single-player immersion and future online ecosystems. As we await further official announcements and deep-dive gameplay trailers, these early confirmations give fans plenty to look forward to regarding the game's systemic depth.

## Editor's Take

The revelation from IGN Games that GTA6 will feature RPG mechanics like eating and exercising is a welcome sign for fans of deep open-world simulations. Small touches like these are what transform a standard sandbox into a living, breathing world. We are eager to see how Rockstar implements these systems without disrupting the classic, fast-paced action the franchise is known for.
